Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing initiative and referendum petitions on 8 1/2 by 11 paper.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to paper size of initiative and referendumpetitions; and amending RCW 29.79.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 29.79.080 and 1982 c 116 s 8 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The person proposing the measure shall print blank petitions uponsingle sheets of paper of good writing quality (including but notlimited to newsprint) not less than ((eleven)) eight and onehalfinches in width and not less than ((fourteen)) eleven inches in length.Each petition at the time of circulating, signing, and filing with thesecretary of state shall consist of not more than one sheet withnumbered lines for not more than twenty signatures, with the prescribedwarning and title, shall be in the form required by RCW 29.79.090,29.79.100, or 29.79.110, ((as now or hereafter amended,)) and shallhave a full, true, and correct copy of the proposed measure referred totherein printed on the reverse side of the petition. The secretary of state shall adopt rules establishing readability p. 1 HB 1014standards, including, but not limited to, the minimum font size of thetext used on the petitions.
